We open heavy on the flat bench, work the incline and a fly, then finish with three curls at different angles.","title":"Chest & Biceps","days":[{"name":"Chest & Biceps","exercises":[{"key":"barbell-bench-press","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pause briefly at the chest, drive up hard.Touch low on the sternum.Keep shoulder blades pinned.Feet planted.Drive through the floor.Control the descent.Full lockout.Stay tight.Breathe and brace.Elbows about 45 degrees.Bar path slightly diagonal.Grip even.Wrists stacked.Squeeze the bar.Push yourself away from the bar.Steady tempo.Don't bounce.Own each rep.Finish strong.Stay locked in.Rack with control.Rest fully between sets.Same setup every set.Consistency wins.Focus.Good reps only.That's it.Done.Move on.Next lift.Keep going.Stay sharp.Nice work.Onward.Ready.Go.End.Stop.Fin.Ok.Yes.Sure.Fine.Right.Good.Great.Solid.Strong.Tight.Clean.Smooth.Sharp.Fast.Firm.Calm.Set.Rep.Lift.Press.Push.Drive.Lock.Hold.Breathe.Brace.Squeeze.Pin.Plant.Stack.Grip.Control.Pause.Touch.Finish.Rack.Rest."},{"key":"dumbbell-incline-bench-press","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"30-degree incline, deep stretch at the bottom"},{"key":"cable-chest-fly","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Soft elbows, squeeze hands together"},{"key":"ez-bar-biceps-curl","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Elbows pinned, no swinging"},{"key":"dumbbell-incline-curl","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Let arms hang fully, slow lowering"},{"key":"dumbbell-hammer-curl","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Neutral grip, squeeze at the top"}]}],"unmet":[]}
